_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pipeline signals

pit_profile.why: Although the majority of the cash generated by KMP’s assets is fee based and is not sensitive to commodity prices, the CO2–KMP business segment is exposed to commodity price risk related to the price volatility of crude oil and natural gas liquids. Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP.

classification.quality_note: Although the majority of the cash generated by KMP’s assets is fee based and is not sensitive to commodity prices, the CO2–KMP business segment is exposed to commodity price risk related to the price volatility of crude oil and natural gas liquids. Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP.. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.16x; +10% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.03; conservative 2yr +80%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY12-FY12 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +36.9%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 1.1-yr ex-FY11 median

BULL.desc: EPS +36.9%/yr (no FY12-FY12 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +36.9%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY12-FY12: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: KMI (retrospective, 2013-02-22) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.16x (13.5% downside to Bear $32 / +83.8% upside to Bull $68) | Adj composite 2.55 vs market 1.52: gap +1.03 [UNDERVALUED] | +10% above the EPP floor $34 (48x FY13E $0.70) | Conservative 2-yr case: +80.5% total (+40.2%/yr) | At 52.9x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $49 sits at or below the BASE case; segment EBDA n/r and Natural Gas Pipelines n/r in Q4 2012, forward revenues +59% (no FY13 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2012 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a pipeline company on this date; none has dated evidence.
